defects.title: Low-resolution 480p mobile photographs cause slight seam boundary softening in armpit junction
reproduction_steps: 1. Capture garment photo at 640x480 resolution on mobile camera with overhead lighting.
2. Upload photograph to PhotoTo3DGarmentModal with category 'top'.
3. Inspect reconstructed 3D GLB wireframe in AvatarStudioViewer under inspection lighting.
4. Observe vertex normal variance and edge softening around axillary sleeve seam junction.
defects.root_cause_analysis: Confidence engine correctly flags image quality warning (0.74 score). Bilinear texture unwarping at 480p loses micro-seam gradients, resulting in slightly smoothed boundary normals.
defects.mitigation_and_fix: Integrated 2x ESRGAN neural super-resolution pre-filter on input uploads with resolution < 720px prior to landmark extraction.

defects.title: Folded flat-lay linen pants initial drape requires 2 simulation steps to resolve planar tension
reproduction_steps: 1. Upload flat-lay photograph of wide-leg linen trousers.
2. Complete reconstruction and load garment onto Ara humanoid avatar.
3. Observe initial frame render before PBD solver settles constraint positions.
4. Note planar tension along inner thigh before cloth physics relaxes.
defects.root_cause_analysis: Initial 3D mesh inflation expands symmetrically before avatar collision volumes engage, taking 2 simulation frames (32ms) to drape smoothly.
defects.mitigation_and_fix: Pre-warmed PBD simulation with 3 headless constraint sub-steps prior to first Three.js canvas paint.

defects.title: Mobile Safari landscape mode safe area notch causes minor toggle overlap
reproduction_steps: 1. Launch Yorvyn Studio on iPhone 15 / 16 in Mobile Safari.
3. Open the digital wardrobe drawer toggle on right boundary.
4. Observe 8px overlap with hardware dynamic island / sensor notch.
defects.root_cause_analysis: Sidebar drawer CSS omitted padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right) in landscape media query.
defects.mitigation_and_fix: Added env(safe-area-inset-right) and env(safe-area-inset-left) CSS rules to AppSideNav and AvatarStudio viewer layouts.
